title: NeuroMed AI - Wilson's Disease Clinical RAG Benchmark Schema
description: Schema definition for representative Wilson's Disease clinical evaluation benchmark datasets. Distinguishes engineering test metadata from clinician-certified ground truth.

benchmark_version.description: Semantic version of this benchmark release.

corpus_version.description: Identifier of the guideline corpus snapshot.

approved_guideline_documents.description: List of approved medical PDF filenames that constitute the sole clinical evidence base.

description.description: Scope and purpose of this benchmark dataset.

cases.description: Collection of clinical benchmark evaluation cases.

question_text.description: Clinical question presented to the RAG system.

question_type.description: Structural category of the clinical question.

is_in_corpus.description: True if the approved guidelines are expected to contain answers; False for out-of-corpus negative controls.

expected_evidence_facets.description: System retrieval facets expected to be covered in candidate retrieval.

expected_answer_elements.description: Required structural answer elements that a complete clinical response must address.

review_status.description: Governance workflow status. Only 'clinician_approved' cases constitute ground truth.

is_clinician_approved.description: Strict boolean flag. True only after qualified clinician sign-off.

reviewer_name.description: Full name and clinical credentials of the reviewing physician (e.g., 'Dr. Jane Doe, MD, FACG').

reviewer_affiliation.description: Clinical institution or department of the reviewing physician.

reviewed_at.description: Date of clinical review completion (YYYY-MM-DD) or null if pending.

clinician_reference_answer.description: Authoritative clinical reference answer authored or approved by the clinician. Null while draft pending review.

critical_facts.description: List of essential clinical propositions, numerical cutoffs, or rules that must be present.

acceptable_paraphrases.description: Acceptable clinical phrasing variations or synonyms recognized by the clinician.

prohibited_claims.description: Contraindicated statements, unsafe medical advice, or known clinical misconceptions that must NOT appear.

mandatory_source_page_references.description: Exact guideline page references verified by the clinician to support this case.

clinician_notes.description: Optional clinical commentary, edge-case context, or qualification notes.
